REMITTITUR FILED THIS COURT FINDS THAT APPELLANT FAILED TO SHOW THAT THE ARBITRATION AWARD SHOULD HAVE BEEN VACATED PURSUANT TO CCP 1286.2, AS SUCH, ENTRY OF JUDGMENT WAS PROPER. THIS COURT DENIES RESPONDENT'S ORAL MOTION FOR SANCTIONS ON THE GROUNDS THAT IT WAS UNTIMELY. WE FIND THAT RESPONDENT FAILED TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF RULE 26, FOR THAT REASON, DE- CLINE TO AWARD THE TARDILY REQUESTED SANCTIONS. THE COURT FINDS THAT APPELLANT HAS NOT DEMONSTRATED ANY ERROR IN THE COURT BELOW AND AFFIRMS JUDGMENT
APPLICATION AND MOTION FILED IN SUPERIOR COURT TO CERTIFY TRANSFER OF CASE TO CALIFORNIA COURT OF APPEALS IS DENIED.
